guide.title: Printer Integration Guide
guide.description: Step-by-step instructions for setting up receipt printing on your device.
guide.desktopStep1: Download QZ Tray from the official website (qz.io).
guide.desktopStep2: Run the installer and follow the on-screen instructions.
guide.desktopStep3: After installation, QZ Tray will appear in your system tray.
guide.desktopStep4: Connect your thermal printer via USB or network.
guide.desktopStep5: Return to NexPOS and go to Settings → Printer Management.
guide.desktopStep6: Click 'Scan Printers' to detect your connected printer.
guide.desktopStep7: Add the printer and set it as the default receipt printer.
guide.desktopStep8: Test printing from any completed order.
guide.mobileStep1: Install the 'RawBT print service' app from Google Play Store.
guide.mobileStep2: Open the RawBT app and pair your Bluetooth thermal printer.
guide.mobileStep3: In RawBT settings, enable 'Default printer' and select your device.
guide.mobileStep4: Return to NexPOS in your mobile browser.
guide.mobileStep5: When you tap 'Print Receipt', NexPOS will automatically open RawBT.
guide.mobileStep6: The receipt will be sent directly to your paired Bluetooth printer.
guide.iosDescription: Direct ESC/POS printing is not available on iOS due to system restrictions.
guide.iosNote1: iOS does not support Bluetooth SPP connections required for ESC/POS printing.
guide.iosNote2: You can use the browser's built-in print function (Share → Print) with an AirPrint-compatible printer.
guide.iosNote3: For best results, we recommend using a desktop or Android device for receipt printing.
guide.troubleshoot1: Printer not detected? Make sure QZ Tray is running and the printer is powered on.
guide.troubleshoot2: Printing fails? Check that the correct printer is set as default in Printer Management.
guide.troubleshoot3: Garbled text? Ensure your printer supports ESC/POS commands.
guide.troubleshoot4: RawBT not opening? Check that the app is installed and Bluetooth is enabled.
